data.name: Add_Cell
data.comment: Button under the last cell that adds one. {0} is the cell type's display name, such as 'Code'.

data.name: CellType_Code
data.comment: Display name of the code cell type on the insert buttons, used when the host does not name it.

data.name: CellType_Markdown
data.comment: Display name of the Markdown cell type on the insert buttons. Markdown is a format name and stays as written.

data.name: Chip_Conflict_Tip
data.value: {0} is assigned in more than one cell, so its links are not tracked
data.comment: Tooltip on the warning badge for a variable written by several cells. {0} is the variable name.

data.name: Chip_Cycle
data.comment: Text of the warning badge on a cell that is part of a dependency cycle. Lower case, drawn after a warning sign.

data.name: Chip_Cycle_Tip
data.value: This cell is on a dependency cycle; cycle edges are excluded from auto-run
data.comment: Tooltip on the cycle badge.

data.name: Chip_Feeds_Tip
data.comment: Tooltip on a badge linking to a cell that uses this value. {0} is the variable name, {1} the cell number.

data.name: Chip_Live_Tip
data.value: {0} follows a control on this page; moving it runs the cells below
data.comment: Tooltip on the badge of a variable bound to an interactive control. {0} is the variable name.

data.name: Chip_Reads_Tip
data.comment: Tooltip on a badge linking to the cell a value comes from. {0} is the variable name, {1} the cell number.

data.name: Common_Off
data.comment: State word inside the auto-run toggle.

data.name: Common_On
data.comment: State word inside the auto-run toggle.

data.name: Empty_Subtitle
data.comment: Line under the empty-notebook heading, pointing at the add buttons.

data.name: Empty_Title
data.comment: Heading in the cell area when the notebook has no cells.

data.name: Header_AutoRun
data.comment: Header toggle showing whether dependents re-run on their own. {0} is Common_On or Common_Off.

data.name: Header_AutoRun_Tip
data.value: When on, running a cell or moving a bound control re-runs the cells that depend on it
data.comment: Tooltip on the auto-run toggle.

data.name: Header_RunDag
data.comment: Header button that runs every cell in dependency order. DAG is an abbreviation and stays as written.

data.name: Header_RunDag_Tip
data.value: Run every cell in dependency order
data.comment: Tooltip on the Run DAG button.

data.name: Header_Title
data.comment: Title at the left of the layout's own header bar. Stays as written.

data.name: Insert_Tip
data.comment: Tooltip on the small insert button between two cells. {0} is the cell type's display name.

data.name: Layout_Description
data.value: Notebook layout with dependency-aware reactive execution: cells that share variables are linked with badges, and running a cell re-runs its dependents in dependency order.
data.comment: Second line of the sample's entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_DisplayName
data.comment: Label in the layout picker. Stays as written.

data.name: Layout_Name
data.comment: Name of the sample extension as listed in the Extensions panel. 'DAG Notebook' is the sample's name and stays as written.
